gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-cairo: Pixelify Sans gives diagonals the same weight as upright strokes, so each display letter looks bent from a single wire. Cairo does the quieter work, opening a wide channel into every bowl.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-cairo-play: A monoline stroke from stem to serif gives Pixelify Sans its bent-wire look. And Cairo Play keeps the reading smooth, its open round letters staying clear even at small sizes.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-cambay: Strokes as constant as bent wire define Pixelify Sans, a bold display face with a c opened like a paperclip. Cambay then reads smoothly, its rounds gapping like a cracked bangle.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-catamaran: Bent-wire and loud, Pixelify Sans holds one width through curves and straights alike. Catamaran loosens things up beneath it, its curvy sans letters feeling unclamped next to that rigid line.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-chakra-petch: Pixelify Sans is bold and expressive, with a steady line weight and a c bent open like a paperclip. Chakra Petch follows with cupped, unclenched round letters and a single-width stroke.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-el-messiri: El Messiri puts a faint swell in every curve, like pulled taffy, against Pixelify Sans and its constant stroke width. El Messiri then keeps the text moving, with a wide slot between each c's two ends.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-encode-sans-sc: Pencil-line consistency, turned up loud: that is Pixelify Sans. Encode Sans SC settles in underneath, its shallow terminal curl and wide gap giving that wiry display line plenty of room.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-encode-sans-semi: Neatly bent pipe cleaner, in letter form: that is bold, expressive Pixelify Sans. Encode Sans Semi Condensed brings the approachable side, a modern sans-serif whose open counter spills onto the s.

Encode Sans Semi Expanded leaves its rounded letters open, a contemporary sans-serif counterpart to Pixelify Sans. Encode Sans Semi Expanded is the loose, open part, while the tubelike heading lines hold constant weight.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-figtree: Bent-wire and loud, Pixelify Sans keeps a steady stroke and a c bent open like a paperclip. But Figtree writes like a marker tip, its e leaving a wide gap at the terminal.
